The site is Highland Guild of Craftsmen — Artisan Directory & Open Studios, a directory-listing web application for Craft guild artisan profiles and studio open days.

Owner brief: "Our county guild of makers needs an online artisan directory showcasing woodworkers, weavers, and glassblowers. Visitors should be able to filter makers by craft discipline, view individual studio opening hours, and search by maker name or town. All directory search queries and filter selections must be shareable via URL parameters."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-06/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Highland Guild of Craftsmen — Artisan Directory & Open Studios: the page for craft guild artisan profiles and studio open days, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #451a03 (cg-bark), #b45309 (cg-copper), #fdfbf7 (cg-parchment), #f5f5f4 (cg-stone), #e7e5e4 (cg-border), #292524 (cg-text), #78716c (cg-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--cg-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a listing card whose entire surface is not the link it appears to be; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Highland Guild of Craftsmen — Artisan Directory & Open Studios as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Artisan name", "Craft discipline", "Studio location and town", "Studio opening hours", "Upcoming open day date", "Artisan biography").

User journey context: Browse the artisan directory, select a craft filter such as ceramics, and see matching makers. Search for a specific artisan by surname and view their detailed workshop profile. Copy and reload a filtered directory URL and observe the same filtered maker list.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
